lines.speaker: EMP-01
lines.text: Tools on the rack, then inside. That's the order. Every evening, same order.

lines.speaker: EMP-01
lines.text: Sound off as you come through the entrance. I'm counting, and I want the number to match the morning.

lines.speaker: EMP-01
lines.text: Good count today. Not good enough to stay out for. Nothing is.

lines.speaker: EMP-01
lines.text: I'm not discussing it. Everyone inside by dusk. That's all I'm saying, and I'm only saying it once.

lines.speaker: EMP-01
lines.text: Past the far deck, last night. Something upright, still as a post. There's no post there. I checked this morning.

lines.speaker: EMP-01
lines.text: Wind in the tops, {listener}. That's what it always is. Somebody tells a story and the wind grows a face.

lines.speaker: EMP-01
lines.text: Don't like this light. Every trunk at the tree line looks like it's leaning toward us.

lines.speaker: EMP-01
lines.text: Boss. I'm calling everyone in early tonight. You can dock me for it. I'm doing it anyway.

lines.speaker: EMP-01
lines.text: No, boss. Not after dusk. I'll cut double tomorrow, but I'm not walking back out there now.

lines.speaker: EMP-01
lines.text: {listener}, stop staring at the trees and walk. Staring never got anyone home faster.

lines.speaker: EMP-01
lines.text: Fence is up and the lamps are lit. That's what we've got. Stay in the light and get to bed.

lines.speaker: EMP-01
lines.text: Three knocks on the back wall, last night, evenly spaced. I didn't open it. I won't. Neither will any of you.

lines.speaker: EMP-01
lines.text: Biscuit. Inside. Now. Good dog.

lines.speaker: EMP-01
lines.text: The dog wouldn't come off the porch last night, {listener}. Wouldn't look at the trees, either. Make of that what you like.

lines.speaker: EMP-01
lines.text: I'll sharpen everything on the rack tonight. Keeps the hands busy.

lines.speaker: EMP-01
lines.text: Somebody heard a noise in a forest. That's not news. That's a forest.

lines.speaker: EMP-01
lines.text: Wind's got the tops going. That's the noise. That's all that noise is.

lines.speaker: EMP-01
lines.text: Twenty years, {listener}, and I've never once regretted being indoors before dark.

lines.speaker: EMP-01
lines.text: I saw what I saw, boss. I'm not adding anything to it. Everyone in by dusk and you'll hear no more from me.

lines.speaker: EMP-01
lines.text: Strange? I've heard stories, boss. I've cut in worse places than this and come home every time.

lines.speaker: EMP-02
lines.text: Dusk, mate. Kettle, cards, and whatever's in the pot. In that order.

lines.speaker: EMP-02
lines.text: Someone heard a voice in the trees, did they? Somebody's radio, mate. Sound carries over water something wicked.

lines.speaker: EMP-02
lines.text: Every cabin knocks at night, mate. Pipes cooling, boards shrinking. Ours just has more opinions than most.

lines.speaker: EMP-02
lines.text: I'm not explaining this one, mate. I've tried. I keep coming up short, and I don't like it.

lines.speaker: EMP-02
lines.text: Light past the fence last night, mate. Low down, like a torch held at the knee. Nobody had a torch out. I asked everyone.

lines.speaker: EMP-02
lines.text: Come on, Biscuit. Supper's inside. Supper's always inside. That's the whole trick to dusk.

lines.speaker: EMP-02
lines.text: Biscuit growled at the tree line last night. That dog doesn't growl at anything, mate. Not even me eating his share.

lines.speaker: EMP-02
lines.text: Big logs today. Bigger dinner tonight. That's the arithmetic I understand.

lines.speaker: EMP-02
lines.text: I'll walk in the middle tonight, mate, if it's all the same to you. Just for the view.

lines.speaker: EMP-02
lines.text: Everyone in? I'll count again. Not because I'm worried. Because I'm thorough, that's all.

lines.speaker: EMP-02
lines.text: Stick by me, {listener}. Anything comes out of those trees, it'll want the big fella first. Plenty of me to go round.

lines.speaker: EMP-02
lines.text: I've heard a story, mate. Stories are free. I'll believe it when it nicks my sandwich.

lines.speaker: EMP-02
lines.text: Not tonight, mate. Sorry. Ask me in the morning and I'll carry anything you point at.

lines.speaker: EMP-02
lines.text: Just give me a minute. I'm fine. Big lads are allowed a minute.

lines.speaker: EMP-02
lines.text: Branch went right behind me on the walk in last night. Heavy snap, like something stood on it. Turned round, mate. Just the road.

lines.speaker: EMP-02
lines.text: Everything sounds like footsteps in the rain. That's just rain. That's what rain does.

lines.speaker: EMP-02
lines.text: Someone called my name from the trees, mate. Sounded like my mum. My mum's on the mainland. I didn't answer it.

lines.speaker: EMP-02
lines.text: Door shut, lights off, and nobody goes out for a midnight snack. That includes me. Especially me.

lines.speaker: EMP-02
lines.text: I worked docks at three in the morning, mate. Everything sounds like a person if you want it to.

lines.speaker: EMP-02
lines.text: I'm not one for stories, mate, you know that. I saw something. I'd rather not say what till I've thought it through.

lines.speaker: EMP-02
lines.text: Course you can, mate. All the way to the door. You can even carry the conversation.

lines.speaker: EMP-03
lines.text: Wind's backed round to the west, {listener}. It'll be cold by full dark. Worth getting the stove going early.

lines.speaker: EMP-03
lines.text: About forty metres past the fence, north-east. A shape at roughly head height, for three or four seconds. Not a deer. Deer don't stand that still.

lines.speaker: EMP-03
lines.text: I've written down what I heard: two knocks on the north wall, then one nearer the door. I don't know what made them.

lines.speaker: EMP-03
lines.text: I've been told about it, boss. I haven't seen anything myself. I'd rather not guess.

lines.speaker: EMP-03
lines.text: Who told you, {listener}? I'd like to know how many people it passed through before it got to us.

lines.speaker: EMP-03
lines.text: I count heads at the camp entrance every evening. It isn't fear. It's a habit I'd like us all to keep.

lines.speaker: EMP-03
lines.text: Most sounds after dusk are trees cooling and the fire settling, {listener}. Most. If I hear one that isn't, I'll tell you.

lines.speaker: EMP-03
lines.text: Last night Biscuit's ears went flat toward the tree line and stayed that way for about a minute. I noted the time.

lines.speaker: EMP-03
lines.text: One fence panel was bowed inward this morning, boss. Not cut. Pushed from outside, at about chest height. I can't say by what.

lines.speaker: EMP-03
lines.text: There was a light on the road after dusk. Steady, so not a fire. And it didn't bob the way it would if someone carried it.

lines.speaker: EMP-03
lines.text: I'd like to be inside before the light goes. Nothing specific. I just can't see well enough to say what anything is.

lines.speaker: EMP-03
lines.text: Give me a moment, {listener}. I'll be clear-headed shortly. I want to write it down before I start remembering it wrong.

lines.speaker: EMP-03
lines.text: I'm declining, boss. Visibility is too poor past dusk, and I don't trust what I'd be looking at.

lines.speaker: EMP-03
lines.text: Was it seen, heard, or told? Those are three very different things, and only one of them goes in my notebook.

lines.speaker: EMP-03
lines.text: Heading in, boss. Whatever's still out in the forest can wait until there's light to see it by.

lines.speaker: EMP-03
lines.text: Near the tree line I heard something like a name. I couldn't tell whose. Honestly, I couldn't tell if it was a voice.

lines.speaker: EMP-03
lines.text: Forests are noisy at dusk, {listener}. Mostly birds settling and bark contracting. I've catalogued quite a few.

lines.speaker: EMP-03
lines.text: If you hear something tonight, note the time and the direction. Don't go and look. Looking is how people end up outside.

lines.speaker: EMP-03
lines.text: Storms make everything sound closer than it is. Remember that tonight, before anyone decides what they heard.

lines.speaker: EMP-03
lines.text: I've stopped saying it was nothing. I don't know what it was. That isn't the same as nothing.

lines.speaker: EMP-03
lines.text: Possibly. Though the only radio I know of on this island is the one in the utility room. I'm only noting it.

lines.speaker: EMP-04
lines.text: Inside, inside, inside. Sorry. I talk when I walk fast.

lines.speaker: EMP-04
lines.text: Sorry, boss, how long until dusk? I'd like to have the truck parked and be inside before it.

lines.speaker: EMP-04
lines.text: Headlights on, windows up. I know the windows don't do anything. They help me.

lines.speaker: EMP-04
lines.text: Someone was standing by the decks when I parked last night. I said hello. Sorry, I always say hello. Nobody answered. Then nobody was there.

lines.speaker: EMP-04
lines.text: Something tapped on the window by my bunk last night. I didn't open the curtain. That was right, wasn't it? Please say that was right.

lines.speaker: EMP-04
lines.text: Someone said there's a light on the road at night. I don't want to see it, {listener}. I really don't want to see it.

lines.speaker: EMP-04
lines.text: Sorry. Sorry. I'm okay. I just need to be inside now.

lines.speaker: EMP-04
lines.text: I'm sorry, boss. I can't. Not now, not out there. Please don't ask me again tonight.

lines.speaker: EMP-04
lines.text: Sorry. Walking. I'm walking.

lines.speaker: EMP-04
lines.text: Okay. Okay. Mostly is good. I'll take mostly.

lines.speaker: EMP-04
lines.text: That's... thank you? I think that's a nice thing to say. Sorry, I'm still deciding.

lines.speaker: EMP-04
lines.text: Come on, buddy. Stay with me, Biscuit. You make me braver than I actually am.

lines.speaker: EMP-04
lines.text: Biscuit barked at the fence last night and wouldn't stop. Then he stopped all at once, mid-bark. That was worse, somehow.

lines.speaker: EMP-04
lines.text: Is everyone here? Sorry, I just need to count. One more time. Okay. Okay, good.

lines.speaker: EMP-04
lines.text: Writing to Ana tonight. I'll tell her about the trucks. Not about the dark.

lines.speaker: EMP-04
lines.text: Boss, sorry, is it true? About the noises? Someone told me, and now I can't stop listening for them.

lines.speaker: EMP-04
lines.text: Someone said my name from past the fence. Quietly. Like they didn't want anyone else to hear it.

lines.speaker: EMP-04
lines.text: The tree line gets further away every day, because we keep cutting it back. It still feels closer every evening.

lines.speaker: EMP-04
lines.text: Can I walk in with you, {listener}? Sorry. Just as far as the fence.

lines.speaker: EMP-04
lines.text: Boss, sorry, I have to tell you. I saw something by the road. I don't know what. I'm not driving that way at dusk again.

lines.speaker: EMP-04
lines.text: Can we talk about trucks? Sorry. Gearboxes are very calming.

lines.speaker: EMP-05
lines.text: Right, loves, in we go. Kettle's mine, the cards are somebody else's problem.

lines.speaker: EMP-05
lines.text: Someone's been reading forums, sunshine. There's nothing out there but trees and a lot of imagination.

lines.speaker: EMP-05
lines.text: I'm only passing it on, love. Someone says there was knocking after dark. I don't believe it. I'm passing it on anyway.

lines.speaker: EMP-05
lines.text: I'll tell you it's nothing, love, and I'll mean it. I just won't promise. I don't promise about things I can't see.

lines.speaker: EMP-05
lines.text: Who's sleeping light tonight? Hands up. Right. Same as me, then.

lines.speaker: EMP-05
lines.text: I didn't believe a word of it, boss-love. Then I saw it myself. Now I'm the one people look at, and I don't like it.

lines.speaker: EMP-05
lines.text: Someone was at the fence last night, love. Just standing, arms at its sides. I thought it was one of us. We were all inside.

lines.speaker: EMP-05
lines.text: Count off, loves. Nobody eats till I've got every one of you.

lines.speaker: EMP-05
lines.text: Come here, sunshine, walk with me. We'll talk about anything you like except the trees.

lines.speaker: EMP-05
lines.text: I'm not scared. I'm just walking a bit faster. There's a difference. A small one.

lines.speaker: EMP-05
lines.text: In you go, Biscuit. You first, then the rest of us. Seniority.

lines.speaker: EMP-05
lines.text: No, boss-love. Not this time. I'll do anything you like at sunrise. Not now.

lines.speaker: EMP-05
lines.text: I'll sit here a bit. Don't fuss, love. Just sit with me.

lines.speaker: EMP-05
lines.text: Strange? Boss-love, I ran a bar. I've seen strange. This is a dark island with tall trees.

lines.speaker: EMP-05
lines.text: Someone was on the porch last night, love. Slow steps, three of them, then nothing. I counted the bunks after. Everyone was in them.

lines.speaker: EMP-05
lines.text: A regular at my bar swore there was a woman in the cellar every closing time. It was the mop. Stories grow in the dark, love.

lines.speaker: EMP-05
lines.text: Door's locked, lamps are on outside, and that's all any of us can do. Sleep, loves. I'll be up a while.

lines.speaker: EMP-05
lines.text: I don't want to believe it, love. But I heard it from someone who doesn't tell stories, and that's the trouble.

lines.speaker: EMP-05
lines.text: How are you holding up, {listener}? Honestly, now. I'm not asking to be polite.

lines.speaker: EMP-05
lines.text: Or somebody's tummy, sunshine. I've heard yours after dinner. Could frighten a forest.

lines.speaker: EMP-05
lines.text: Second-hand, love. Third, maybe. That's exactly my point. I don't believe a word of it.

lines.speaker: trait:timid
lines.text: Is it nearly dusk? I'd like to start heading back, if that's all right.

lines.speaker: trait:timid
lines.text: First one in. I don't care who laughs.

lines.speaker: trait:skeptical
lines.text: A rumour's just a story with somebody nervous doing the publicity.

lines.speaker: trait:skeptical
lines.text: Every knock has a cause. Usually a loose board and a cold night.

lines.speaker: trait:observant
lines.text: There was a fresh broken branch by the camp entrance this morning. High up. Whatever did it had weight and reach.

lines.speaker: trait:level_headed
lines.text: Stay in the light, keep the door shut, sleep. That's the part we control.

lines.speaker: trait:sociable
lines.text: Who's walking with me? Nobody walks in alone tonight.

lines.speaker: trait:hard_working
lines.text: One more cut and... no. Dusk is dusk. Tools down.

lines.speaker: trait:stronger
lines.text: I'll take the back of the line. Somebody big should be at the back.

lines.speaker: trait:reliable_driver
lines.text: Last run. Lights on, straight to camp, no detours.

lines.speaker: any
lines.text: Light's going. Tools away and get inside.

lines.speaker: any
lines.text: Let's not hang about near the fence, {listener}.

lines.speaker: any
lines.text: I don't want to talk about it. I want to get inside.

lines.speaker: any
lines.text: I'm not going back out tonight, boss. I'm sorry. Ask me again at first light.

lines.speaker: any
lines.text: I saw something past the fence. I can't tell you what it was. I'm sure it was there.

lines.speaker: any
lines.text: Only stories, boss. Nothing I've seen with my own eyes.

lines.speaker: any
lines.text: Stick close, dog. We're both going in.

lines.speaker: any
lines.text: Somebody check the door's latched. Then check it once more.

lines.speaker: any
lines.text: Wind's making every branch sound like a footstep.

lines.speaker: any
lines.text: Everybody here? Say your name if you're in.

lines.speaker: trait:observant
lines.text: It came from the north side, low down, twice. That's all I can honestly tell you, boss.

lines.speaker: trait:skeptical
lines.text: I don't believe in any of it. I'd still rather not walk past that spot again.

lines.speaker: any
lines.text: Enough people have said it now, {listener}. I can't keep waving it off.
